crossRefs.note: “Woe to the world because of occasions of stumbling! For it must be that the occasions come, but woe to that person…
He said to the disciples, “It is impossible that no occasions of stumbling should come, but woe to him through whom…
Men will arise from among your own selves, speaking perverse things, to draw away the disciples after them.
But the Spirit says expressly that in later times some will fall away from the faith, paying attention to seducing…
through the hypocrisy of men who speak lies, branded in their own conscience as with a hot iron,
But false prophets also arose among the people, as false teachers will also be among you, who will secretly bring in…
Many will follow their immoral ways, and as a result, the way of the truth will be maligned.
But the high priest rose up, and all those who were with him (which is the sect of the Sadducees), and they were filled…
But some of the sect of the Pharisees who believed rose up, saying, “It is necessary to circumcise them, and to command…
For we have found this man to be a plague, an instigator of insurrections among all the Jews throughout the world, and…
But this I confess to you, that after the Way, which they call a sect, so I serve the God of our fathers, believing all…
having known me from the first, if they are willing to testify, that after the strictest sect of our religion I lived a…
But we desire to hear from you what you think. For, as concerning this sect, it is known to us that everywhere it is…
idolatry, sorcery, hatred, strife, jealousies, outbursts of anger, rivalries, divisions, heresies,
Avoid a factious man after a first and second warning,
you shall not listen to the words of that prophet, or to that dreamer of dreams; for Yahweh your God is testing you, to…
Yes, a sword will pierce through your own soul, that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.”
Examine your own selves, whether you are in the faith. Test your own selves. Or don’t you know about your own selves…
They went out from us, but they didn’t belong to us; for if they had belonged to us, they would have continued with us.…

translations.web: For there also must be factions among you, that those who are approved may be revealed among you.
translations.bsb: And indeed, there must be differences among you to show which of you are approved.
translations.kjv: For there must be also heresies among you, that they which are approved may be made manifest among you.
translations.asv: For there must be also factions among you, that they that are approved may be made manifest among you.
